Sources, dates & interpretation
+

The economic path is an attributed forecast. The near-term paths are conditional interpretations, without assigned probabilities or price targets.

Equity trends use the most recent 50 and 200 observed closes. Currency strength is measured against the US dollar and carries its own observation date.

Recent high reference: 252 observed closes, 2025-10-01 → 2026-10-15. Currency observation: —.

Revision figures compare the same provider, measure and target period across identified editions. A difference between forecasters is a separate published view. Annual inflation uses an annual average; monthly inflation observations use year-over-year rates.

Government balance: General government. Sector and instrument coverage can differ across countries; this is not a sovereign-risk ranking.

Gross government debt: General government. Sector and instrument coverage can differ across countries; this is not a sovereign-risk ranking. Japan gross debt is reported on a nonconsolidated basis.

BIS statistics are attributed to the Bank for International Settlements. Chinese translations are not official BIS translations. No endorsement is implied.
